title_en: Supplementary Arrangement of the Supreme People's Court on Mutual Enforcement of Arbitral Awards Between the Mainland and the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region

articles.content_en: 1. The procedure for enforcement of arbitral awards made in the Mainland or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region as referred to in the Arrangement shall be construed as including the procedure for recognition and enforcement of arbitral awards made in the Mainland or the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.

2. The preamble and Article 1 of the Arrangement shall be amended as follows: 'In accordance with the provisions of Article 95 of the Basic Law of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region of the People's Republic of China, after consultation between the Supreme People's Court and the Government of the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region (hereinafter referred to as the Hong Kong SAR), the following Arrangement is made on the mutual enforcement of arbitral awards:
"1. This Arrangement shall apply to the enforcement by the People's Court in the Mainland of arbitral awards made under the Arbitration Ordinance of the Hong Kong SAR, and the enforcement by the courts of the Hong Kong SAR of arbitral awards made under the Arbitration Law of the People's Republic of China."'

3. Paragraph 3 of Article 2 of the Arrangement shall be amended as follows: 'If the respondent has domicile or property available for enforcement in both the Mainland and the Hong Kong SAR, the applicant may apply to the courts of both places for enforcement. At the request of the other court, the courts of both places shall provide each other with information on the enforcement of the arbitral award by their respective courts. The total amount of property enforced by the courts of both places shall not exceed the amount determined in the award.'

4. A new paragraph shall be added to Article 6 of the Arrangement as paragraph 2: 'Before or after accepting an application for enforcement of an arbitral award, the relevant court may, upon application and in accordance with the legal provisions of the place of enforcement, adopt preservation or compulsory measures.'

5. Articles 1 and 4 of this Supplementary Arrangement shall come into force on November 27, 2020. Articles 2 and 3 shall have their date of coming into force announced by the Supreme People's Court after the completion of relevant procedures in the Hong Kong Special Administrative Region.
